subject: SIG export preflight + portal stapling / file-naming for ACME procurement
body:
From: acme_procurement@acme.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG export + upload guidance for ACME procurement (REQ-123)

Hi Irene,

We're completing the procurement package for our security review (REQ-123) and need the following from Redwood: an export of the completed SIG questionnaire as a single PDF (flattened, with responses and evidence references), a short manifest, and any summary of SOC 2 scope that maps to SIG sections. We'll be uploading to OneTrust (portal link below).

Specific asks:
- A single PDF with the questionnaire and inline evidence references or links.
- A CSV manifest that lists each attachment, the related SIG question id, and a short description.
- A SOC 2 bridge/summary document (one page if possible).
- Confirmation of recommended file-naming convention and whether you can stamp files with a request id.

Can you confirm ETA? We need to begin portal upload on Monday.

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
acme_procurement@acme.com

---

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: acme_procurement@acme.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG export + upload guidance for ACME procurement (REQ-123)

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the package and provide upload guidance for OneTrust. Proposed plan and deliverables below:

Deliverables (ETA: same day, 5pm PT):
- SIG_export_ACME_REQ123_20270402.pdf — flattened PDF that includes the full SIG Q&A with inline footnotes pointing to evidence.
- manifest_ACME_REQ123_20270402.csv — columns: filename, question_id, doc_type, short_description, internal_link
- SOC2-bridge-summary-20270402.pdf — 1–2 page mapping of SOC 2 in-scope systems to SIG sections.
- evidence_s3_links_20270402.txt — S3 pre-signed links for large artifacts (if you prefer direct download vs attached).

File-naming and stamping:
- We'll prefix all files with your request id: ACME_REQ123_YYYYMMDD. Example: ACME_REQ123_SIG_export_20270402.pdf.
- We can add a simple PDF footer on the flattened SIG export with: "Redwood Inference — ACME_REQ123 — Exported 2027-04-02". This is not a signed/legal stamp, just an export footer for traceability. If you need a certified stamp, we will route to Legal (adds 2–3 business days).

OneTrust upload tips (short):
1) Create a single bundle folder named: ACME_REQ123_20270402
2) Upload SIG_export...pdf and manifest...csv first. OneTrust prefers the manifest CSV in the root of the bundle.
3) For large evidence, either upload directly to OneTrust or paste the pre-signed S3 links into the manifest column.
4) When uploading multiple files, avoid special characters; use underscore and dashes only.

Attachments below will include the actual files. Let me know if you want us to perform the upload on your behalf (we can, but requires a short access token or a delegate user).

Best,
Irene Choi
Manager, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_export_ACME_REQ123_20270402.pdf (stub), manifest_ACME_REQ123_20270402.csv (stub), SOC2-bridge-summary-20270402.pdf (stub), evidence_s3_links_20270402.txt (stub)

---

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Request: SIG export + upload guidance for ACME procurement (REQ-123)

Quick notes on evidence packaging (internal):
- For the SIG export, make sure each inline footnote uses the canonical internal doc id (e.g., S3 key) so we can refresh links without republishing the PDF.
- Add a checksum column to the manifest (sha256) for binary attachments—we had a OneTrust reviewer ask for this in a recent upload.
- For anything that references PII/production screenshots, swap with redacted screenshots and link to the pre-signed S3 artifact in the manifest.
- If procurement asks for a vendor questionnaire ID, include it in the PDF footer and the manifest.

I'll upload the SOC2-bridge-summary I drafted and the S3 links file to the compliance bucket. Irene — ping me if you want me to apply the footer.

Sergio
Sr. Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-bridge-summary-20270402.pdf (uploaded to s3://redwood-inference-compliance/sig/ACME_REQ123/), evidence_s3_links_20270402.txt (uploaded)

---

From: acme_procurement@acme.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG export + upload guidance for ACME procurement (REQ-123)

Irene / Sergio — received the package and the upload guidance. We completed the OneTrust bundle upload this morning (portal confirmation ID: OT-55421). The manifest format you provided worked well; we used the pre-signed S3 links for large artifacts.

Two quick follow-ups:
- Can you confirm whether the PDF footer will persist across subsequent exports? We may request periodic refreshes.
- We noted one evidence item (attachment id: evidence-45) had a broken link in the manifest; can you replace the pre-signed link for that file?

Otherwise, thanks for the quick turnaround — we'll circle back if Legal needs anything extra.

Best,
Jane
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp

---

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: acme_procurement@acme.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG export + upload guidance for ACME procurement (REQ-123)

Thanks Jane — quick answers:
- Footer persistence: yes, we can keep a standard footer template for your request id. If you need refreshed exports on a cadence (monthly/quarterly) we can schedule and automate.
- Broken link: Sergio has re-issued a new pre-signed URL for evidence-45 and updated the manifest. Attached new manifest and evidence link file.

I'll send a confirmation once the updated manifest is uploaded to OneTrust.

Regards,
Irene
Manager, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: manifest_ACME_REQ123_20270405.csv (stub), evidence_s3_links_20270405.txt (stub)
